name: Plyometric Push-Up
steps: Set up in a straight high-plank position on the floor with your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width and your core and glutes braced.
Lower your chest smoothly toward the floor with your elbows angled roughly 45 degrees from your torso.
Drive explosively through your palms to push your entire upper body upward with enough force that your hands leave the floor.
Land softly on your palms with slightly bent elbows, immediately absorbing the impact into the next lowering phase.
tips: Maintain a rigid plank from head to heels instead of letting your lower back sag on takeoff or landing.
Catch yourself softly with bent elbows rather than landing with locked arms.
